scope: The HTTPS, channel-binding and Kerberos rows of wsman-tls.json and wsman-kerberos.json measured again with no SSH tunnel: the Mac reached the lab hosts and the KDC by their own addresses

path.client: Mac mini, Apple M4, macOS 26.6.2, address 192.168.1.119 on the home LAN
path.route: 192.168.50.0/24 via 192.168.1.201 (a Windows host with IPv4 forwarding on, one hop); traceroute shows 192.168.1.201 as hop 1 and the lab hosts answer ICMP and TCP directly
path.names: /etc/hosts entries for dc01, cm01 and client01 under contoso.com; the lab has no DNS reachable from the Mac
path.krb5_conf: [libdefaults] default_realm = CONTOSO.COM, dns_lookup_kdc = false, dns_lookup_realm = false; [realms] CONTOSO.COM kdc = dc01.contoso.com; [domain_realm] .contoso.com and contoso.com = CONTOSO.COM; selected with KRB5_CONFIG
path.environment: WMIC_WSMAN_CONNECT and WMIC_WSMAN_PORT unset; /node names the host; WMIC_WSMAN_SCHEME=https with WMIC_WSMAN_CA_FILE for the HTTPS rows

hosts.cm01.contoso.com: Windows Server 2025 Datacenter Evaluation, domain member, HTTP 5985 and HTTPS 5986 with its self-signed certificate (cm01.pem)
hosts.client01.contoso.com: Windows 11 Enterprise Evaluation, domain member, HTTP 5985 and HTTPS 5986 with its self-signed certificate (client01.pem)
hosts.cbt_hardening_level: Relaxed (default) for the relaxed and principal batches; Strict on both listeners for the strict and flip batches; restored to Relaxed and read back

builds.flipped: the same source with flip-channel-binding.patch applied, built separately

runs.note: 0xAC5D truncated to 8 bits by the shell; classic WMIC exits 44125

server_events.source: Security logs of the hosts and the KDC, filtered to source address 192.168.1.119 (the Mac itself) during the batches

tooling: flat-run.ps1 (private helper): one ssh session per case, the password on the ssh stdin stream, exit code and line count recorded per case
